entities.name: Wincenty Teofil Popiel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wincenty Teofil Popiel-Chościak was a Polish Catholic priest, Bishop of Płock from 1863 to 1875, Bishop of Kujawy–Kaliska from 1876 to 1883, and the metropolitan Archbishop of Warsaw from 1883 to 1912.
